essence: Those who bow with devotion are not afflicted by Kali.
Kali becomes the servant of virtuous persons vowed to helping others.
For truth-vowed Kaulas, welfare arises from mere resolve.
In the Kali age, people experience not only merit but also demerit.
People devoted to harming others are servants of Kali.
